welcome_subtitle: Your control center to manage patients, appointments, and finances.
intro_message: Use the left sidebar navigation menu (or bottom on mobile) to access all your clinic management tools.
tool_home_desc: The welcome page and overall summary of recent activity.
tool_patients_desc: Manage your complete patient registry, medical history, and contacts.
tool_appointments_desc: Schedule, modify, and review your patients' appointment calendar.
tool_inventory_desc: Track your clinic's stock of medications, supplies, and equipment.
tool_billing_desc: Manage charges, issue invoices, and keep track of income.
tool_themes_desc: Customize the appearance of your dashboard with different color schemes.
tool_settings_desc: Set up your profile, language preferences, and advanced app settings.
